name: Email and password sign-in (Supabase Auth REST)
description: Sign up, sign in and sign out with email and password against Supabase Auth over HTTPS, with the session in the Keychain and a configuration message until keys are added.

credentialsNeeded.description: Your project's anon (public) key; protect data with row-level security

cost.note: Supabase has a free tier and paid plans; check current limits on its pricing page

usage: At the composition root: `EmailAuthModel(service: SupabaseEmailAuth.fromBundle(), store: KeychainStore())`; `fromBundle()` returns nil until real keys are in .env, and the model then reports `isConfigured == false`. Call `model.restore()` at launch. Show `EmailAuthForm(model:)` until `model.state` is `.signedIn(session)`. Previews: `EmailAuthModel(service: nil, store: InMemorySecureStore())`.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify email-password-auth` on a Mac with XcodeGen.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
